## Problem

Lowest unit price does not necessarily mean the least money spent for the amount needed this week.

## Scope

Add optional desired quantity to staples/list entries and calculate whole-package outlay and excess using eligible offers in the selected channel.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] For fixed-size packages, compute ceiling(required amount / package amount), total price and excess with Decimal arithmetic.
- [ ] Display unit-price and purchase-cost winners distinctly; preserve the current behavior when desired quantity is absent.
- [ ] Reject incompatible units. Treat variable-weight/approximate packages explicitly as estimates or unsupported, never exact totals.
- [ ] Exclude conditional offers and unavailable/stale/unapproved products using the same engine rules.
- [ ] Tests cover exact multiples, partial packages, bulk versus small packs, count items, incompatible units and missing quantity. No travel or coupon optimization.

## Dependencies and starting point

Blocked by #11.

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/BUILD_PLAN.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `API_CONTRACT.md` first. Integration work also reads `docs/SOURCES.md`. Use an isolated checkout and keep edits to shared persistence/API files sequential.

## Boundaries

No Costco, receipts, automated retail login, fabricated prices, automatic substitute approval, public deployment, or notification delivery. Keep comparison channels and observed price timestamps honest.

## Problem

A manual refresh path needs bounded daily operation and honest failure visibility before users can depend on recurring comparisons.

## Scope

Add a refresh runner and documented Mac launchd setup/removal for validated connected adapters only. Do not install or activate a recurring job as a side effect of writing code.

- [ ] Enforce at most one scheduled refresh per day and prevent overlapping runs with a durable lock/run policy.
- [ ] Use modest timeouts, bounded retries/backoff and per-source caching; do not hammer an unavailable source.
- [ ] A source failure does not stop other stores or change prior observed-at timestamps.
- [ ] Show last attempt, last success and failure reason separately; log without leaking credentials or private payloads.
- [ ] Document Mac sleep/offline behavior, manual invocation and explicit activation/removal steps.
- [ ] Deterministic tests cover concurrency, repeated runs, retry exhaustion and independent failures. At least one validated adapter is required for a live scheduled smoke check.

## Problem

The brief reports a working Wegmans API, but this repository has no reproduced request or confirmed price-field mapping.

## Scope

Run a bounded research spike for five representative grocery products. Request the previously working endpoint details if the public developer documentation is insufficient. This issue delivers evidence, not a production adapter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record the exact supported request/access requirements, location evidence, and in-store versus ordering mode.
- [ ] Capture five sanitized response fixtures with retailer product ID, barcode when available, package size/count, seller if relevant, price, availability, and offer conditions.
- [ ] Map fields to the planned observation schema, distinguishing source price/effective time from retrieval time.
- [ ] Do not derive shelf prices by reversing a general online markup.
- [ ] Update docs/SOURCES.md with a reproducible supported approach or a specific blocker and next step; never claim success from a store homepage alone.
- [ ] If access is not viable, the research issue may close with evidence; its implementation issue stays blocked. No automated login or challenge bypass.

## Dependencies and starting point

No prerequisite issue. Ready to start.

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/BUILD_PLAN.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `API_CONTRACT.md` first. Integration work also reads `docs/SOURCES.md`. Use an isolated checkout and keep edits to shared persistence/API files sequential.

## Verification

Deliver sanitized evidence and the documented outcome; no test data should be inserted into the user database.

## Boundaries

No Costco, receipts, automated retail login, fabricated prices, automatic substitute approval, public deployment, or notification delivery. Keep comparison channels and observed price timestamps honest.
